user.title: Select an existing FT-11W feeder
user.description: Select the FT-11W already configured in LocalTuya. This integration uses its existing LAN connection. Only audited xZetsubou LocalTuya 2026.07.0 non-write-only transports can capture reports or write schedules. No query can guarantee a fresh DP1 schedule; an unknown plan cannot be edited.

error.device_missing: The selected LocalTuya device no longer exists.

abort.no_devices: Configure your FT-11W in LocalTuya first.

set_schedule.name: Set complete schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace DP1 with a validated every-day plan. Existing meals must all be included. Sends once, waits for a matching locally received DP1 report, and never retries automatically. Does not dispense food immediately.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Use the exact integer revision from the last reported snapshot.

meals.name: Complete meals
meals.description: List of records containing days (all seven lowercase weekdays), time (HH:MM), portions (integer 1–60), enabled (boolean). Maximum ten records, including disabled meals.
